hypothesis: A reward-label error changes the memory written from an otherwise identical agent trajectory, creating a direct channel from proxy reward noise into future memory-conditioned behavior.

sampling.selection_rule: lowest task IDs with complete trajectory_json within each original-outcome stratum after deterministic parsing

intervention.changed: memory-construction reward label through the exact released ReasoningBank success versus failure system prompt

primary_metrics.paired_exact_content_change_rate: fraction of trajectories whose success-label and failure-label memories differ after whitespace normalization
primary_metrics.paired_token_jaccard_distance: 1 - token-set Jaccard similarity between paired memories
primary_metrics.paired_title_set_change_rate: fraction of pairs with different extracted memory-item title sets

falsifier.stop_current_mechanism_if: paired exact content change rate is zero, or all six paired outputs are semantically identical under manual audit despite prompt-label changes

experiment_debt_after_f0: inject paired memories into matched future tasks
measure downstream action and success variance under fixed benchmark state
